text: Implemented optional stdlib catalog/plan/verify/import/export and OASIS byte-range fetch with explicit network budget; legacy fetch delegates to same checked backend. Ten offline tests and five existing evaluator tests passed; registry valid. Imported all three extant local datasets with original hashes, round-tripped a real T1 bundle, and materialized the existing OASIS archive through both new and legacy APIs with every image/mask hash matching; zero large/network downloads during these checks. Public endpoint honored a 30-byte range probe. Actual dataset verification log .agent-work/locus-landing-20261005/dataset-portability/existing-data.log (exit 0, 7.68s). Private/unknown-source data stays import/export only and scientifically unqualified.
